newsitem.title: FRANCE: French to decide on EMU, not Chirac - Socialists.
newsitem.headline: French to decide on EMU, not Chirac - Socialists.

text.p: Acting French Socialist party chief Francois Hollande said on Tuesday the French nation and parliament would decide whether to enter a single European currency, not President Jacques Chirac.
When asked for his reaction to Chirac's insistence on bringing France into the euro on time, Hollande said:
"The euro will be decided by the nation by means of the parliament, and I think we will debate all through this process," Hollande told RMC radio in an interview.

"(Prime Minister) Lionel Jospin has said he wants a dialogue with the country without talking of a referendum...but in any case, there will be a discussion in parliament...and in these conditions, no one can claim the title of privileged defender of the nation to make or not make the euro.
"I think it will be in light of the country's interests that we must decide."
